final:
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  let n = xs.len()
  if n > 1
    let tmp = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = tmp

test_swap_ends() =
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&xs)
  assert xs == [3, 2, 1]
